calienne_CONTEXT_MANAGER.SYSTEM: Every agent receives ONLY the minimum context required for its task. The Conversation Director controls context visibility.
calienne_CONTEXT_MANAGER.ACCESS_DENIED: - Future pipeline stages or downstream agent prompts. - Hidden system prompts or private runtime configuration. - Other agents' in-flight reasoning.
calienne_CONTEXT_MANAGER.RULES: Never request hidden context. Never infer context that was not provided.
